title: SUPER. V. ALMA continuum observations of z ∼ 2 AGN and the elusive evidence of outflows influencing star formation
question: What is the impact of AGN ionised outflows on obscured and unobscured star formation in z ~ 2 AGN host galaxies?

recipe.goal: Phase-centrevisibilities, remove secondary sources, and image ALMA Band 7 continuum
recipe.method: Run standard ALMA pipeline in CASA 5.4.0, phase-centre the calibrated measurement set on the 2D Gaussian centroid using fixvis, model and subtract secondary sources in three fields (cid_451, cid_1205, cid_1143) with a 2D Gaussian and uvsub, and image with tclean using natural weighting (Briggs robust = 2).
key_parameters: cleaning threshold = 2xRMS, pixel size = 1/5 beam size, Briggs robust = 2 (and tested robust = 0.5)

recipe.goal: Measure FIR continuum sizes, morphologies, and flux densities
recipe.method: Extract visibility amplitudes from phase-centred MS, bin in 50 klambda uv-distance intervals, and fit symmetric point source, 2D Gaussian, 2D Gaussian + point source, and exponential (Sersic n=1) models in Python using MCMC (PyStan), selecting the best model via BIC. Also fit 2D Gaussian in uv-plane with CASA uvmodelfit (for axial ratio and PA) and in image plane with CASA viewer.
key_parameters: uv-distance bin width = 50 klambda; uvmodelfit iterations = 20; S/N >= 8 threshold for reliable sizes
assumptions: Cosmology: Omega_lambda = 0.7, Omega_M = 0.3, H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1; symmetrical models (axial ratio = 1) for collapsed visibility fits

recipe.goal: Fit UV-to-FIR SEDs and quantify AGN and synchrotron contributions to 260 um flux
recipe.method: Fit UV-to-FIR photometry including ALMA Band 7 fluxes using CIGALE to derive M_star, SFR, and AGN torus contribution at rest-frame 260 um; cross-check with F_870um/F_24um diagnostic, a modified black-body (MBB) torus model, and radio-extrapolated power-law synchrotron emission.
key_parameters: IR integration range = 8-1000 um; dust emissivity index beta = 1.8 for MBB test; radio spectral index alpha_r measured from 1.4/3/5.5/100 GHz data or fixed to -0.7
assumptions: Kennicutt (1998) SFR calibration converted to Chabrier (2003) IMF by subtracting 0.23 dex; optically thin dust with beta = 1.8 for MBB test; no radio variability between frequencies

recipe.goal: Compare FIR sizes of AGN and non-AGN across literature samples
recipe.method: Compile z ~ 1.5 - 2.5 samples with high-resolution (<0.5") ALMA Band 7 continuum sizes and S/N > 8, and compare FIR half-light radii (R_e) between AGN and non-AGN using two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) tests and Monte Carlo error resampling.
key_parameters: S/N > 8 threshold; sub-tests with F_870um < 4 mJy, M_star > 10^11 M_sun, and 100 Monte Carlo realisations within the Tadaki et al. (2020) sample

recipe.goal: Register SINFONI astrometry, fit optical emission lines, and compare spatial distributions of FIR, Halpha, [O III], and outflows
recipe.method: Align VLT/VISTA and VLT/ISAAC H/K-band images to Gaia DR2 using Starlink GAIA, align collapsed SINFONI cubes to broadband centroids, fit Hbeta+[O III] and Halpha+[N II] spectra with multi-Gaussian components, create narrow [-300, 300] km s^-1 and outflow (< -300 and > 300 km s^-1) velocity maps, and fit 2D Gaussians with scipy.optimize.curve_fit to compare centroids and sizes with ALMA FIR maps.
key_parameters: Systemic velocity channel = [-300, 300] km s^-1; outflow channels: v < -300 km s^-1 and v > 300 km s^-1 (also tested > 600 km s^-1); [N II] and [O III] doublet ratio fixed to 2.99; line detection threshold S/N >= 3 (5sigma upper limits otherwise)
assumptions: No dust extinction correction applied to emission line fluxes; w_80 > 600 km s^-1 indicates AGN-driven outflow

score_reason: ALMA calibration, phase-centring, imaging parameters, and uv-plane functional forms/priors are clearly specified and all intermediate and final numeric results are tabulated in detail (Tables 1-3, A.1, B.1-B.2), with minor omissions limited to custom fitting scripts and SINFONI cube products.
